motion-observe.mjs records class mutations, transitions and hover computed diffs only — attribute-driven state machines (aria-expanded dropdown) and inline-style swaps (hamburger icons, menu display:block) are invisible; both had to be recovered with a manual before/after click probe (capture/chrome-open-probe.mjs → chrome-open-{1440,360}.json). Suggest recording attribute mutations and inline style changes.
anchor.mjs prints no sections on the live AEM page (no section/.section children under the root) — live side yields only doc height; band mapping had to come from the lift + pixel bands.

chrome-parity.mjs reports ICON signature deltas for locally hashed asset filenames (same image, basename-hash suffix) — permanent noise for any replica that stores media as <basename>-<hash>; comparing the basename before the hash would silence it.
